rows.name: WBTC
farm_steps: Open a fresh wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm on WBTC, and keep its seed phrase offline. Fund it with $2,000–$5,000 plus gas for the first transaction on Bitcoin. Cost: one transaction at $0.10–$2. Time: 10 minutes to set up.

Bridge $2,000–$5,000 of USDC through WBTC onto Bitcoin, then use the bridged funds inside an app on that chain instead of bridging straight back. Keep transactions to a few per week and batch them where the app allows.
Do about 2 qualifying actions a week on WBTC (Bitcoin) — deposits, swaps, votes or claims — gas is $0.10–$2 a transaction. Cost: about $8.60 of gas over 30 days. Time: 15 minutes a week, 12 weeks.
Hold the position for at least 90 days and open WBTC's own points or rewards page once a month to check the activity is counted. Cost: no fee to check. Time: 10 minutes a month for 12 weeks.

When the horizon ends, claim only from the link WBTC itself publishes, never pay to claim, and write the wallet, dates and every transaction in a farm log before you unwind. Cost: one exit transaction at $0.10–$2. Time: 15 minutes.

When the horizon ends, claim only from the link BounceBit Prime itself publishes, never pay to claim, and write the wallet, dates and every transaction in a farm log before you unwind. Cost: one exit transaction at $0.10–$1. Time: 15 minutes.

Bridge $250–$750 of USDC through Sophon Bridge onto Ethereum, then use the bridged funds inside an app on that chain instead of bridging straight back. Keep it to few, larger transactions so the gas is covered by the allocation size.

Do one qualifying action every two weeks on Sophon Bridge (Ethereum) — a top-up, a borrow-and-repay, or a vote — and skip the in-between weeks: at $6–$20 a transaction, weekly churn costs more than it adds. Cost: about $28 a month in gas. Time: 15 minutes every two weeks, 12 weeks.
Hold the position for at least 45 days and open Sophon Bridge's own points or rewards page once a month to check the activity is counted. Cost: no fee to check. Time: 10 minutes a month for 12 weeks.

When the horizon ends, claim only from the link Sophon Bridge itself publishes, never pay to claim, and write the wallet, dates and every transaction in a farm log before you unwind. Cost: one exit transaction at $6–$20. Time: 15 minutes.

Deposit $250–$750 of USDC as margin on Antarctic on Arbitrum, open one small hedged position, and close it before the funding window resets. Gas is under $0.50 a transaction, so split the work into small weekly actions.

Do about 4 qualifying actions a week on Antarctic (Arbitrum) — deposits, swaps, votes or claims — gas is under $0.50 a transaction. Cost: about $1.72 of gas over 30 days. Time: 15 minutes a week, 12 weeks.
Hold the position for at least 60 days and open Antarctic's own points or rewards page once a month to check the activity is counted. Cost: no fee to check. Time: 10 minutes a month for 12 weeks.

When the horizon ends, claim only from the link Antarctic itself publishes, never pay to claim, and write the wallet, dates and every transaction in a farm log before you unwind. Cost: one exit transaction at under $0.50. Time: 15 minutes.

Stake $250–$750 of the chain's staking asset through Stakee on TON and hold the receipt token in the same wallet. Keep transactions to a few per week and batch them where the app allows.
Do about 2 qualifying actions a week on Stakee (TON) — deposits, swaps, votes or claims — gas is $0.10–$2 a transaction. Cost: about $8.60 of gas over 30 days. Time: 15 minutes a week, 12 weeks.
Hold the position for at least 45 days and open Stakee's own points or rewards page once a month to check the activity is counted. Cost: no fee to check. Time: 10 minutes a month for 12 weeks.

When the horizon ends, claim only from the link Stakee itself publishes, never pay to claim, and write the wallet, dates and every transaction in a farm log before you unwind. Cost: one exit transaction at $0.10–$2. Time: 15 minutes.
